records.title: Quantum entropy couples matter with geometry
records.version: arXiv 2404.08556v4 14 Aug 2024, author preprint; published J. Phys. A 57 365002 2024. Equations below preprint v4 numbering.
objects: chosen 2-dimensional oriented cell complex K with N0 nodes,N1 edges,N2 2-cells
Dirac operator d and gauge-induced metric Ghat

equations.meaning: Different cochain-type fields already exist on a preselected cell complex, not generated by raw unordered hyperedge occurrence.

equations.formula: G=diag(G0,G1,G2), G>0; V=det G=exp(Tr ln G)
equations.meaning: Positive metric and metric-dependent network volume are explicit variables of original framework; not derived from primitive source event action.

equations.formula: d=G^{-1/2} B† G^{1/2}, with B built from gauge-coupled oriented boundary matrices; d=d_[1]+d_[2]
equations.meaning: Dirac/exterior derivative operator requires oriented cell-boundary maps and metric, not just untyped incidence Gram.

equations.formula: S_+=σ Tr ln G + Tr[G(ln G−ln Ghat)]−Tr G; S_−=σ Tr ln G + Tr[G(ln G+ln Ghat)]−Tr G
equations.meaning: Generalized matrix relative-entropy-like actions with a trace-volume term and positive matrix variables, not classical KL or primitive entropy pressure.

preloaded: cell complex dimension 2 for general derivation, a separately chosen 3-dimensional lattice in section 4
metric G and oriented boundary operators
spinor, matter and gauge variables, complex cochains
real action parameter σ and matrix log domain
topology fixed while metric varies; topology dynamics flagged by author as future work
records.candidateCorrespondence: Compare native multiway incidence to a *hypothetical* cell-boundary chain with proven ∂²=0; any metric and spinor must be separately justified.
records.sourceObstruction: Native bit-mutating rank-k occurrence is not a topological 2-cell with oriented edges or constant topology. Injecting Bianconi G, Dirac d or a fixed dimension would violate source premises.
records.theoremNotReproduced: Field equations varied from S± not independently proved; original author proposes theory without empirical verification as fundamental quantum gravity.
records.sourceInspection: Original arxiv PDF screenshots pp4,6,8 and original assumptions in Introduction original text read.

records.title: Quantum correlations with no causal order
records.version: Original arXiv 1105.4464 preprint, Nature Communications 3 1092 (2012), equations preprint numbering.
objects: two quantum laboratories A,B each with input/output Hilbert spaces
local completely positive (CP) instruments via Choi operators
positive semidefinite process matrix W with linear normalization
probability P(local outcomes | selected local CP instruments)

equations.formula: W^{A1A2B1B2}≥0; Tr[W(M^A⊗M^B)]=1 for all CPTP local maps M^A,M^B
equations.meaning: A valid process is constrained by positive quantum operators and normalized local instruments, **not** just a DAG or bit-event scheduler.
Causally separable class mixtures of two definite one-way orders, contrasted to causally nonseparable examples.

preloaded: quantum Hilbert spaces and Choi CP/CPTP operator calculus
local quantum mechanics at each laboratory
does not assume a global definite event order but that alone does not construct a primitive higher-order hypergraph
records.candidateCorrespondence: Check scope of native operational causation/order observers; only after deriving valid local quantum instruments can one test process-matrix constraints.
records.sourceObstruction: Changing native scheduler order is ordinary classical nondeterminism; quantum causal nonseparability is not implied by state-dependent T4 event enabling or 660 triple guards.
records.theoremNotReproduced: Paper's causal-inequality violation/probability construction not independently reproduced.
records.sourceInspection: Original paper PDF page 4 Eq4–6 and original publisher article abstract viewed.
